name: Karwendelbahn
kurzbeschreibung: The Karwendelbahn cable car ascends from Mittenwald to 2,244 m on the Karwendelspitze, featuring a giant telescope visitor centre, panoramic paths, and Dammkar vistas.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The iconic Karwendelbahn aerial tramway whisks visitors from Mittenwald right on the Bavarian-Tyrolean frontier up to a dramatic mountain terminal at 2,244 metres elevation on the Westliche Karwendelspitze in just ten minutes. Overcoming immense vertical cliffs, it provides effortless access to the high-alpine core of the vast Karwendel Nature Park. Perched dramatically at the summit rim stands the 'Bergwelt Karwendel' exhibition centre, designed to resemble an immense telescope projecting daringly over the chasm. From the observation gallery, sightseers enjoy a spellbinding 360-degree panorama embracing the Isar river valley, the Wetterstein massif with Mount Zugspitze, the Mieming plateau, and the rugged limestone bastions of the Karwendel. The station also unlocks the famed Dammkar basin, Germany's longest freeride ski descent in winter and a revered hiking hub throughout summer.

Route & Anforderungen

Circling the summit crest, the circular Passamani Panorama Trail offers a rewarding 45-minute stroll covering roughly one kilometre. The protected high-altitude path weaves through raw scree terrain, offering dizzying vertical perspectives toward the villages of Scharnitz and Seefeld in Tirol. Sturdy walking footwear with lugged soles is recommended. For seasoned mountaineers, the station serves as the gateway to the celebrated Mittenwald Via Ferrata (klettersteig set and helmet strictly required). The gravel panoramic loop contains steps and is unsuitable for prams.

Besuch & Anreise

The valley base station is conveniently located on the eastern edge of Mittenwald, accessible via the federal B2 motorway and regional routes from Innsbruck, Seefeld, and Scharnitz. Dedicated pay parking is situated at the terminal. Rail travelers alight at Mittenwald station on the Karwendel line, reaching the cable car in a 15-minute walk or via local shuttle bus.

Tipps

Explore the innovative interactive wildlife exhibition housed inside the giant telescope structure of Bergwelt Karwendel. On clear days, views extend to the Bavarian pre-Alps and the Stubai glaciers. Afterwards, unwind on the sun terrace of the summit panorama restaurant with authentic alpine refreshments.
preis: Round trip adults approx. €35, child reductions available; Bergwelt Karwendel admission included
oeffnungszeiten: Operates daily May through early November and Christmas to Easter (subject to maintenance periods)
